item.title: Design Consistent Hashing
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: A beginner-friendly deep dive into consistent hashing — the algorithm that powers Amazon DynamoDB, Apache Cassandra, Discord, and Akamai CDN. Understand hash rings, virtual nodes, and why this algorithm changed distributed systems forever.
